after.title: $250 American Express Venue Collection Concessions Credit
after.description: 10% back in statement credits on qualifying food and beverage concessions purchases at participating stadiums and arenas in the American Express Venue Collection, up to $250 per calendar year. Enrollment required.
after.expiration_note: Calendar-year cap; unused amounts do not roll over.
after.notes: Enroll the Aspire card in the Benefits section of your Amex account. Each eligible Basic Card is enrolled separately; Additional Card Members cannot enroll, but their qualifying purchases earn credits on the enrolled account, capped at $250 per enrolled Card Account per calendar year. Merchandise, tickets, parking, and suite/catering orders do not qualify. Log the 10% amount received on each qualifying purchase.

changes.summary: From January 6, 2027 the Amex Venue Collection concessions credit can be enrolled separately on each eligible card, so the Hilton Aspire gets its own 10% back, up to $250 per calendar year. Until then Amex allows one enrolled card per Card Member, and you track it on the Delta Reserve.
